sources.community: GitHub Issues API: /issues?state=open&per_page=100&sort=created&direction=desc, external-author filter (owners: Amm0Bot, mobileskyfi)
sources.work: GitHub Issues API (same page as community, all authors) + Pulls API /pulls?state=open&per_page=100 for draft flags; no bodies/comments
sources.npm: GitHub contents API for package.json + npm registry packument https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg> (dist-tags, versions, time)
